summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting two registered direct offerings, raising ~$6.8M combined. On Aug 18, 2026, it sold 340,000 common shares at $3.00 and 260,000 pre-funded warrants at $2.999; on Aug 20, it sold 451,250 shares at $3.20 and warrants for 1,111,250 shares. These issuances dilute existing holders but are routine capital raises, not a return of capital. The original additional allocation right was terminated. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for further dilution and Nasdaq listing compliance.
